checkpoint.sourceCompleteCountMeaning: Rows marked fully complete with the ledger-required source evidence; this is not a count of existing implementation and does not mean zero code has been written. The mutable working tree has substantial implemented and partially implemented source.

latestSourceInspection.method: Equal-count source-inspection estimate based on the historical row audit and targeted current-source checks. Present includes completed pieces of partial tasks; partial subrequirements receive no assumed percentage credit.
latestSourceInspection.limitations: Not an exhaustive execution, verified effort estimate, fresh classification of all ledger rows, frozen candidate or code-complete evidence. Five evidence-only or acceptance-only items were excluded.

diagnosticSourceIdentity.limitation: Tree-plus-content-hashed working-tree delta is a diagnostic identity, not a standalone staged source snapshot, current test result, or release gate.

provisionalSavedAudit.limitation: These are historical reviewer classifications on an unhashed mutable tree; individual public paths, bundled requirements and tests remain to be reconciled on a candidate.

illustrativeGoalProgressEstimate.method: Equal-weight 1,901 audit outcomes, count the 1,009 source rows classified implemented at full credit, the 687 partial rows at half credit, and missing, unknown and 81 acceptance-only rows at zero.
illustrativeGoalProgressEstimate.limitation: Partial depth and row effort are unknown, the audit predates later changes, and this is not a measured current completion or code-complete gate.

candidateBoundSourceCompletion.limitation: No outcome has complete candidate-bound source evidence. This does not mean that no implementation exists.

ledgerSourceStatusCounts.limitation: These are current ledger status fields, not a fresh exhaustive code audit or candidate-tested completion count.
